## About
Transmission Axle & Driveline, or TAD, is a drive shaft shop on W Louise Dr in Phoenix. We specialize in custom drive shafts for cars, trucks and SUVs, and we carry factory replacements too. No job is too big or too small.
Bring us a vibration you can't pin down, a project truck that needs a new front shaft, or a custom build with non stock parts. We'll look at the problem with you, go over your options, and explain the benefits of each before we get to work.
Neighbors have given us a 4.7 rating across 117 Google reviews. If you're anywhere near North Phoenix, stop by or give us a call.

## Services
- Custom drive shafts: Complete custom drive shafts made to order for cars, trucks and SUVs, including project and custom builds.
- Factory replacement drive shafts: Factory replacements when you just need things back the way they were.
- Carbon fiber shafts: Carbon fiber shafts are now available through the shop.
- U-joints in stock: We keep u-joints for any make, model or year in our inventory.
- Reman existing driveshafts: We can reman your existing driveshaft instead of starting over.
- Shorten or lengthen any shaft: We can shorten or lengthen a shaft to fit your build.
- Computer balance: We can computer balance any shaft.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Give us a call at the shop and we'll get you a quote on any of our services.

Q: Do you work on cars, trucks and SUVs?
A: Yes. We specialize in custom drive shafts for cars, trucks and SUVs.

- "I brought my Jeep to TAD’s for driveline issues. They correctly diagnosed a failing double Cardan and completely rebuilt both driveshafts—mechanically, the result is excellent and the Jeep drives like new. However, two things undermined the experience: when I came to pick up the vehicle, the technician was searching around inside the cabin/under the seats (unclear why; nothing went missing, but it felt careless). More importantly, the Jeep was apparently left on overnight, draining an expensive battery; they jump-started it and that was it. I appreciate the quality of the repair, but I expected better stewardship of the vehicle and proactive follow-up on the battery incident.
*Update:
Dean called me personally, was courteous, and addressed both concerns. I wish I’d reached out sooner so he could have reviewed camera footage (it had already overwritten), but he took the time to walk through what likely happened and how they can prevent it going forward. Between the quality of the repair and the respectful follow-up, I’m satisfied with the outcome and will continue to use TAD’s for future needs." (Luis “Mr.Kopriti” Glinos, 4/5)
